purpose: Compose the exact Pass 133 palindromic SECDED BigInt carrier with deterministic Pass 210 HFC multi-register framing without broadening either inherited claim boundary.

invariants.P211-I1: 5184 Boolean cells pack to exactly 648 bytes.
invariants.P211-I2: The Pass 133 carrier bytes are sharded without normalization, truncation, reordering, or alternate serialization.
invariants.P211-I3: Every non-final shard contains exactly 648 payload bytes and every final shard records its exact payload bit length.
invariants.P211-I4: Every shard retains independent Hash72, Hash216, phase, frame, snapshot, and HFC receipt anchors.
invariants.P211-I5: The package root commits to the ordered shard roots, carrier identity, source identity, Pass 133 witness, shard count, and final-shard bit length.
invariants.P211-I6: One deterministic package-level Hash72 receipt commits the package root and ordered shard roots.
invariants.P211-I7: Missing, duplicate, reordered, substituted, mis-sized, or non-zero-padded shards fail closed.
invariants.P211-I8: All HFC reconstruction and erasure recovery completes before Pass 133 carrier decoding.
invariants.P211-I9: Fresh-against-fresh projection agreement is contemporaneous consistency only; historical integrity requires a retained minted anchor.
invariants.P211-I10: Strict compression remains per-shard and receipt-gated to the Pass 210 declared affine-Fibonacci admissible domain.
invariants.P211-I11: Metrics separately report source bytes, carrier expansion, canonical HFC storage, packed capacity, and multi-register use without conflating them.
invariants.P211-I12: Zero and negative ciphertext values remain rejected by the inherited Pass 133 positive BigInt envelope.

agreement_semantics: hfc_agree establishes consistency among supplied projections. A uniformly changed source can generate mutually agreeing fresh projections. Pass 211 historical corruption detection therefore compares fresh reads against independently retained shard anchors minted at package creation.

unconditional: ordered shard substitution and reordering detection
compression_claim_boundary.domain_restricted: Strict-size compression is claimed only for an individual register admitted by Pass 210 under HFC_ADMISSIBLE_AFFINE_FIBONACCI_MOD2_V1.
